primary_source: Software-file validation metrics. Early rounds log_aligned_estimate; last round saved_native_final_crosschecked. Handwritten numerical values are not used.
summary_method: Mean of four points per complete round, then mean of complete rounds per height/eye. Planned round 11 omitted from four-point summaries only; other three points retained.
extra_calibration_missing_rule: No OCR fill-in for absent native results. Only planned rounds 14-18 have native upper-left calibration results.
